project_meta.title: प्लास्टिक की बोतलें कैसे बनती हैं? कचरे से नई बोतल तक!

global_style.art_style: Pure hand-drawn stickman explainer animation in a clean whiteboard cartoon style. Every scene must look like a colourful educational doodle drawn by hand, NOT realistic, NOT 3D, NOT a cinematic cartoon world. Use a plain warm-white background with subtle paper texture. The main presenter is a consistent simple black stickman with a round white face, bold black outline, expressive eyes, curved eyebrows, a smiling mouth, thin black arms and legs, and simple cartoon hands. The stickman is the main character and must actively interact with the illustrations: pointing, explaining, holding objects, scratching his head, reacting with surprise, walking, jumping, and gesturing toward viewers. Manufacturing objects should be colourful, simple, recognisable hand-drawn illustrations with thick black outlines and bright flat fills. Use blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and red accents. Show each manufacturing step using large clear illustrations, arrows, labels, and visual transformations. Keep the composition uncluttered and readable. Use multiple different visual elements in every beat. The stickman should appear in most beats and should never look like a realistic human. Consistent presenter design in every image. Educational YouTube explainer aesthetic, playful, friendly, highly engaging, easy to understand at a glance.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, realistic humans, 3D characters, anime, prehistoric environments, realistic factories, detailed industrial photography, complicated machinery, dark backgrounds, dirty horror-like garbage scenes, overly detailed textures, tiny unreadable text, static presenter, different stickman designs, inconsistent character proportions, cluttered compositions, excessive gradients, dull colours, cinematic lighting.

host.label: Stickman Presenter
host.visual_dna: A simple friendly hand-drawn stickman presenter. Round white face with a thick black outline, two expressive black eyes, curved eyebrows, a smiling mouth, thin black stick arms and legs, simple cartoon hands, and a small red bow tie. Consistent head size, body proportions, facial design, and bow tie in every scene. Highly expressive and energetic.

whiteboard.label: Whiteboard Background
whiteboard.visual_dna: A clean warm-white drawing canvas with very subtle paper texture, plenty of empty space, and occasional colourful hand-drawn arrows, circles, and labels. No realistic environment.

plastic_scrap.label: Discarded Plastic Waste
plastic_scrap.visual_dna: A pile of discarded plastic packaging, bottles, and containers illustrated as simple hand-drawn shapes. Include black, dark grey, blue, green, and transparent-looking plastic pieces. Colourful black-outlined doodle style, not dirty or disgusting.

used_pet_bottles.label: Used PET Bottles
used_pet_bottles.visual_dna: Several empty used transparent PET water bottles with simple blue caps, light blue highlights, and visible dents. Hand-drawn flat colourful illustration with bold black outlines.

sorting_belt.label: Sorting Conveyor
sorting_belt.visual_dna: A simplified hand-drawn conveyor belt with colourful plastic bottles moving along it. Clear blue and grey shapes, bold black outlines, and a few simple sorting arrows.

sorting_bins.label: Plastic Sorting Bins
sorting_bins.visual_dna: Three simple colourful hand-drawn collection bins: one for clear plastic, one for coloured plastic, and one for unsuitable mixed plastic. Large simple symbols and clean visual distinction.

clean_bottle.label: Clean Clear PET Bottle
clean_bottle.visual_dna: A transparent-looking PET water bottle drawn with light cyan outlines, white highlights, and a few pale blue reflections. It should look clean and polished, with a removable blue cap and label.

washing_machine.label: Plastic Washing Machine
washing_machine.visual_dna: A simplified colourful industrial washing machine illustrated like a hand-drawn doodle. Large blue water tank, spinning drum, bubbles, water splashes, and simple control buttons. No realistic machinery detail.

plastic_flakes.label: PET Plastic Flakes
plastic_flakes.visual_dna: A pile of small light-blue and transparent-looking plastic flakes, like tiny irregular plastic chips. Clean, bright, hand-drawn illustration with bold black outlines.

plastic_pellets.label: PET Plastic Pellets
plastic_pellets.visual_dna: A handful of tiny uniform pale transparent-blue PET plastic pellets, represented as small rounded granules. Clean, colourful, simple doodle style.

extruder.label: Plastic Extruder
extruder.visual_dna: A simplified hand-drawn plastic processing machine with a hopper at the top, a long heating barrel, a small temperature indicator, and a nozzle. Use blue, orange, and grey flat colours with thick black outlines.

molten_plastic.label: Molten PET Plastic
molten_plastic.visual_dna: A glowing orange-yellow stream of melted plastic flowing from a simple machine nozzle. Cartoon hand-drawn liquid shape, smooth and bright, with small heat marks.

preform.label: Bottle Preform
preform.visual_dna: A small transparent pale-blue plastic tube shaped like a thick test tube with a finished bottle neck and screw threads. Clearly recognisable as a bottle preform, hand-drawn with bold outlines.

mould.label: Bottle Mould
mould.visual_dna: A simple open two-piece metal bottle mould with a bottle-shaped hollow cavity. Drawn in blue-grey flat colours with thick black outlines and simple mechanical details.

air_nozzle.label: High Pressure Air Nozzle
air_nozzle.visual_dna: A simplified industrial air nozzle connected to a blue pipe, releasing visible blue air arrows into a plastic bottle preform.

finished_bottle.label: Finished Transparent Bottle
finished_bottle.visual_dna: A beautiful clean transparent water bottle with pale cyan edges, bright white reflective highlights, a blue screw cap, and a simple blue label. Hand-drawn colourful illustration with thick black outlines.

quality_check.label: Quality Inspection
quality_check.visual_dna: A hand-drawn magnifying glass, green check marks, a transparent bottle silhouette, and simple inspection symbols. Bright green, blue, and yellow colours.

bottle_collection.label: Finished Bottle Collection
bottle_collection.visual_dna: A neat row of colourful finished plastic bottles: transparent water bottles, pale-blue bottles, green bottles, and clear bottles with different simple labels. Bright flat hand-drawn illustration.

recycling_symbol.label: Recycling Symbol
recycling_symbol.visual_dna: A large hand-drawn green recycling symbol made from three thick curved arrows, with a small transparent bottle in the centre.

black_product.label: Dark Recycled Plastic Product
black_product.visual_dna: A simple dark-grey recycled plastic object such as a sturdy plant pot or industrial crate, drawn with thick black outlines and a small green recycling symbol.

beats.narration_text: दोस्तों, आपके हाथ में जो पानी की बोतल है, क्या आपने कभी सोचा है कि ये बनती कैसे है?
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} standing on the left, holding {assets.finished_bottle} in one hand and pointing excitedly toward it with the other. Add a large colourful question mark above the bottle. Clean whiteboard background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the stickman host and the mystery of how a plastic bottle is manufactured.

beats.narration_text: और मज़ेदार बात ये है कि कई नई प्लास्टिक की बोतलें पुरानी इस्तेमाल की हुई बोतलों से भी बनाई जा सकती हैं!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} pointing from {assets.used_pet_bottles} on the left toward a shiny {assets.finished_bottle} on the right. Draw a big curved green arrow connecting the old bottles to the new bottle. Add a surprised expression to the stickman.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the recycling concept with a clear old-to-new visual transformation.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन रुकिए! पुरानी बोतल को उठाकर सीधे नई बोतल नहीं बना देते। इसके पीछे पूरी मशीनों वाली कहानी है!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} trying to push an old {assets.used_pet_bottles} directly into a finished bottle shape, then looking shocked as a red cross appears. Beside him, draw a simple sequence of machine icons with a green arrow.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Create curiosity about the actual multi-step manufacturing process.

beats.narration_text: चलो देखते हैं कि प्लास्टिक का कचरा कैसे बदलकर एक चमचमाती बोतल बन जाता है!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} jumping excitedly and pointing toward a large illustrated process arrow: used bottles, tiny flakes, pellets, bottle preform, finished bottle. Use five large colourful icons arranged left to right.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preview the full manufacturing journey and transition into the first step.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले इकट्ठा किया जाता है इस्तेमाल किया हुआ प्लास्टिक। लेकिन हर तरह का प्लास्टिक एक जैसा नहीं होता।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} standing beside {assets.plastic_scrap}, pointing at the different shapes and colours. Add simple floating labels represented by clean hand-drawn symbols for bottles, containers, and mixed plastic.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce plastic waste collection and explain that different plastic types need different treatment.

beats.narration_text: पानी की बोतलों में अक्सर पीईटी नाम का प्लास्टिक इस्तेमाल होता है। इसलिए सबसे पहले सही पीईटी बोतलें अलग की जाती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} holding a large transparent {assets.used_pet_bottles} bottle. Draw a big magnifying glass over it and a green check mark. Keep other mixed plastic pieces faded in the background.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce PET bottles as the selected material for this recycling process.

beats.narration_text: फिर मशीनें और कर्मचारी बोतलों को उनके रंग और प्लास्टिक के प्रकार के हिसाब से छाँटते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.sorting_belt} moving clear, blue, green, and dark plastic bottles. {assets.host} stands beside it, pointing at each bottle as it moves toward {assets.sorting_bins}. Use simple arrows showing clear bottles going into one bin and coloured bottles into another.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the sorting stage with clearly separated plastic colours.

beats.narration_text: और एक ज़रूरी बात! काला या मिला-जुला प्लास्टिक सीधे पारदर्शी बोतल नहीं बन जाता। उसे अलग तरह से इस्तेमाल करना पड़ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} pointing toward two distinct paths. On the left, clear PET bottles move toward a transparent bottle icon with a green arrow. On the right, dark mixed plastic moves toward {assets.black_product} with a grey arrow. Add a red cross between dark mixed plastic and the transparent bottle to show that ordinary recycling cannot simply make it clear.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Correct the misconception that black mixed plastic can simply become a transparent bottle through ordinary recycling.

beats.narration_text: अब चुनी हुई बोतलों से उनके ढक्कन और लेबल हटाए जाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} holding a used bottle while a blue cap and colourful label are separated from it. Draw the cap flying into one small container and the label peeling away. Keep the bottle itself clear and recognisable.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show removal of caps and labels before processing.

beats.narration_text: इसके बाद बोतलों को छोटे-छोटे टुकड़ों में काट दिया जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show a simplified hand-drawn cutting machine with a large opening. On one side, intact {assets.used_pet_bottles} enter; on the other side, a pile of small {assets.plastic_flakes} comes out. {assets.host} points at the flakes with an excited expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the transformation from whole bottles into small PET flakes.

beats.narration_text: अब इन टुकड़ों को पानी और खास सफाई की प्रक्रिया से धोया जाता है, ताकि गंदगी और बचे हुए लेबल हट सकें।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.plastic_flakes} entering {assets.washing_machine}. Draw blue water splashes, white soap bubbles, and tiny dirt particles being washed away. {assets.host} stands beside the machine wearing imaginary safety goggles and giving a thumbs-up.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Explain washing and cleaning of the plastic flakes.

beats.narration_text: सफाई के बाद टुकड़ों को सुखाया जाता है और उनकी क्वालिटी भी जाँची जाती है।
beats.prompt_action: Show clean light-blue {assets.plastic_flakes} spread on a simple drying tray. Beside them, show {assets.quality_check}. {assets.host} holds a magnifying glass and inspects the clean flakes.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the cleaned and dried PET flakes ready for further processing.

beats.narration_text: अब इन साफ टुकड़ों को प्रोसेस करके छोटे-छोटे प्लास्टिक के दाने बनाए जा सकते हैं, जिन्हें पेलेट्स कहते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} holding {assets.plastic_flakes} in one hand and {assets.plastic_pellets} in the other. Draw a thick blue arrow between them. Make the difference between flakes and small rounded pellets very clear.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce PET pellets as the processed material used for manufacturing.

beats.narration_text: इन दानों को गर्म करके पिघलाया जाता है, जिससे प्लास्टिक दोबारा आकार देने लायक बन जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.plastic_pellets} falling into the hopper of {assets.extruder}. Inside a simplified transparent cutaway, draw the pellets becoming a smooth orange-yellow {assets.molten_plastic} stream. {assets.host} points at the heated section.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the pellets being heated and melted in a simplified industrial process.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन बोतल अभी नहीं बनी है। फिलहाल प्लास्टिक को एक छोटे मोटे ट्यूब जैसे आकार में ढाला जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.molten_plastic} flowing into a simple moulding shape and emerging as {assets.preform}. {assets.host} holds the small preform next to his face, looking confused because it does not look like a bottle yet.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the bottle preform and create curiosity about how it becomes a full-sized bottle.

beats.narration_text: इसे बोतल का प्रीफॉर्म कहते हैं। देखने में छोटा है, लेकिन असली बोतल का आकार इसी से बनने वाला है!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} holding {assets.preform} on one side and a large outline of {assets.finished_bottle} on the other. Draw a bold curved arrow between them and make the stickman gesture dramatically toward the tiny preform.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasise that the small preform is the starting shape for the finished bottle.

beats.narration_text: अब आता है सबसे मज़ेदार हिस्सा! प्रीफॉर्म को गर्म करके एक खास साँचे के अंदर रखा जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} pointing toward {assets.mould}, which is open like two halves of a bottle-shaped case. A small warm {assets.preform} is positioned above the mould. Use orange heat lines and blue machine details.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the bottle mould and prepare for the blowing process.

beats.narration_text: फिर उसमें तेज़ दबाव से हवा भरी जाती है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.air_nozzle} entering the top of {assets.preform} while it sits inside {assets.mould}. Draw several thick blue arrows showing air flowing downward into the preform. {assets.host} watches closely from the side.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show high-pressure air entering the heated preform inside the mould.

beats.narration_text: हवा के दबाव से गर्म प्लास्टिक फैलता है और साँचे की दीवारों से चिपककर बोतल जैसा आकार ले लेता है!
beats.prompt_action: Show a clear simplified cutaway of {assets.mould}. Inside, {assets.preform} expands outward into the shape of {assets.finished_bottle}. Use large blue arrows pointing outward and a playful expanding effect. {assets.host} jumps backward in amazement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show stretch blow moulding as the dramatic transformation from preform to bottle.

beats.narration_text: और जब साँचा खुलता है... सामने आती है एक नई, पारदर्शी प्लास्टिक की बोतल!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.mould} opening into two halves. A shiny transparent {assets.finished_bottle} appears in the centre with bright cyan highlights and sparkling hand-drawn stars. {assets.host} celebrates with both arms raised.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the finished transparent bottle in a colourful celebratory moment.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन काम अभी खत्म नहीं हुआ। हर बोतल की जाँच की जाती है कि उसका आकार और मजबूती सही है या नहीं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} inspecting {assets.finished_bottle} with a large magnifying glass. Add {assets.quality_check} symbols around the bottle, including a green check mark and a small warning symbol beside a defective bottle silhouette.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show quality control and rejection of defective bottles.

beats.narration_text: फिर उस पर ढक्कन और लेबल लगाया जाता है, और बोतल पैकिंग के लिए तैयार हो जाती है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} placing a blue cap onto {assets.finished_bottle}. A colourful label wraps around the bottle, and several finished bottles appear neatly arranged beside it. Use simple arrows to show cap, label, and final product.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the final assembly and packaging preparation.

beats.narration_text: और इस तरह पुरानी बोतलों से मिला प्लास्टिक, सही सफाई और प्रोसेसिंग के बाद फिर से काम आ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show a colourful circular recycling diagram: {assets.used_pet_bottles} transforms into {assets.plastic_flakes}, then {assets.plastic_pellets}, then {assets.preform}, and finally {assets.finished_bottle}. {assets.host} walks along the arrows, pointing to each stage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Summarise the recycling journey from used PET bottles to new bottle products.

beats.narration_text: तो अगली बार जब आप पानी की बोतल देखें, याद रखना... इसके पीछे कितनी सारी मशीनें और कितने सारे स्टेप्स छिपे हैं! आपको अगली बार किस चीज़ का बनना देखना है? कमेंट में बताइए!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.host} standing beside a large shiny {assets.finished_bottle} and a colourful row of {assets.bottle_collection}. He points directly toward the viewer with one hand and gives a thumbs-up with the other. Add three small floating doodle icons of a shoe, a glass jar, and a paper cup to suggest future how-it-is-made videos. Keep the background clean and colourful.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Finish with a direct-to-viewer question and an invitation to suggest the next manufacturing explainer.
